California bars Waymo driverless cars from freeways

California has banned Waymo's driverless vehicles from operating on state freeways, citing repeated incursions into active construction zones and an "imminent hazard" to public safety. Following this decision, Waymo has paused its freeway operations in all its US markets and is reviewing its performance. The ban by the California DMV means Waymo cannot test or operate its autonomous vehicles on state highways.
